## Checklist

- [ ] `go vet ./... && go test -race ./...` pass
- [ ] Tested by hand (say how: real Discord, `tools/mockdiscord`, which OS and browser)
- [ ] Error messages tell the user what to do; anything a user may need to fix shows up in `doctor`
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed
